[RBND.1.5] The two bindings are the only artifact-to-artifact
comparators this spec defines. Comparators that consume a
subset of either tuple (e.g. "DSC hash only") are not permitted
as fail-closed gates; they may appear in informational
diagnostics. The two bindings are checked independently — a
mismatch in either is fatal per [RBND.5].
